site.proofing.faq.account.a.text: No. The link opens the gallery in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer, where they can look through the photos, rate them and leave notes straight away. Anyone with the link can rate until it expires, so send it to the people choosing.
site.proofing.faq.account.a.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: answer to "Does my client need an account or an app?". site.proofing.faq.after.a.text: They stay in the collection, with the notes, for as long as the photos are in it. Turn rating off to hide them, and on again to bring them back.

site.proofing.faq.need.a.text: An Off The Cloud device, a Raspberry Pi 5 with two USB drives or another 64-bit computer running Debian or Ubuntu, and its address at off-the.cloud, such as studio.off-the.cloud, which is where your client's link opens. You share and read the ratings in the web app.
site.proofing.faq.need.a.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: answer to "What do I need?". Keep the address studio.off-the.cloud exactly as it is. The web app: Off The Cloud's own web app.

site.proofing.faq.need.q.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: a question.

site.proofing.faq.self.a.text: Yes. Turn on rating in any collection, Favourites included, give photos stars and a note in the viewer, then filter and sort them the same way. Each photo has one rating per collection, shared with the collection's gallery link, and the viewer marks the ratings that came through the link.
site.proofing.faq.self.a.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: answer to "Can I rate photos myself?". Rating: the collection's switch that turns stars and notes on; use the apps' word for it. Favourites: the collection every device has, as the apps name it. The viewer: the screen that shows one photo large.

site.proofing.faq.self.q.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: a question. Rate: give stars to a photo.

site.proofing.faq.where.a.text: On your Off The Cloud device. Sharing makes a copy of the collection there, encrypted with a key that only the link carries, and your client's browser gets the photos from it. Deleting the link deletes its copy.
site.proofing.faq.where.a.note: Website, the page for photographers about client proofing (off-the.cloud/client-proofing-gallery): questions at the bottom of the page: answer to "Where are the photos while the link is open?". A security statement: keep its meaning exact.

site.proofing.hero.lead.text: Share a shoot with your client as a gallery link. They open it on any phone or computer, give stars to the photos they like and leave a note wherever they'd like a change. You get an alert, open the collection and see their picks, best first. The photos stay on your own Off The Cloud device, and the link expires by itself.
